info.title: Portaliq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas owned by the Portaliq external-portal application.

x-openregister.description: Portaliq — the fleet's shared external portal for clients and suppliers (ADR-046).

portalAccount.title: Portal Account
portalAccount.description: Links an external identity (eHerkenning / DigiD / eIDAS) to the subject reference used for RBAC scoping. Owned by Portaliq's auth edge; never publicly readable. See ADR-046 and openspec/changes/supplier-portal.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which external audience this account belongs to. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — e.g. supplier, client, citizen, organisation, student, parent, external-employee, data-subject, signer, participant, vendor-org. Not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

identityType.title: Identity type
identityType.description: The external identity provider that authenticated this account.

identityRef.title: Identity reference
identityRef.description: Pseudonymous identity reference from the IdP (e.g. eHerkenning KvK number for suppliers, or a pairwise pseudonym for clients). Not a raw BSN.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The reference the domain apps scope their data by (e.g. procest supplierRef). Server-derived; never accepted from the client.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant (OpenRegister Organisation) this account belongs to.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Human-readable name for the portal UI.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email for notifications (masked in logs).

lastLoginAt.title: Last login at
lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Server-managed per-app claim map linking this account to domain identities: {appId: {claimName: uuid}} (ADR-046 contract v2, A4). Written only by Portaliq server code / admin tooling — never accepted from a client. Collections select a claim via scopeClaim.

portalSession.title: Portal Session
portalSession.description: A bearer session issued by Portaliq's auth edge. Records the minted token id (jti) so sessions can be revoked. Owned by Portaliq; never publicly readable.

accountRef.title: Account reference
accountRef.description: Reference to the portalAccount this session was issued for.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject reference carried in the token (server-derived).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: The external audience of this session. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this session is scoped to.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: Unique token identifier (JWT jti claim) for revocation.

trustLevel.title: Trust level
trustLevel.description: Assurance level of the authentication (e.g. eHerkenning EH3, DigiD Midden/Substantieel).

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Whether the session has been explicitly revoked (logout / admin).

exampleDocument.title: Example Document
exampleDocument.description: A demo subject-scoped content object so the portal object reader is exercisable end-to-end. Carries subjectRef so PortalObjectReader can scope it. Replace with real, app-owned content schemas (procest ships supplierContract etc.).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject this document belongs to; the field PortalObjectReader scopes on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this document belongs to.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable title shown in the portal.

portalMessage.title: Portal Message
portalMessage.description: A message in a subject's portal inbox (the in-portal realisation of the notification/inbox surface). Subject-scoped by subjectRef, so it is read through the same path as any contribution collection. OpenRegister's notification engine (email channel + `field` recipient kind) can additionally email the subject out-of-band when a message arrives.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The recipient subject; the field the inbox is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this message belongs to.

read.title: Read
read.description: Whether the subject has read the message.

aard.title: Aard
aard.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the nature of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when the contributing app supplies it; absent means no such field renders.

rechtsgevolg.title: Rechtsgevolg
rechtsgevolg.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the legal effect of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when supplied.

termijn.title: Termijn
termijn.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the deadline associated with the message/decision (e.g. an objection period). Optional — rendered only when supplied.

referenceId.title: Reference id
referenceId.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): the receipt's own reference id, shown to the subject and linked from the matching `portalSubmission` proof-log entry's `receiptMessageRef`. Present only on a receipt message; absent on an ordinary domain notification.

dataCopy.title: Data copy
dataCopy.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): a copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the subject's right to a copy of what they submitted. Present only on a receipt message; never contains a non-whitelisted or raw client field.

portalSubmission.title: Portal Submission
portalSubmission.description: Append-only proof-of-receipt log record satisfying the WMEBV burden-of-proof duty (~Awb 2:25): one row per successful portal create-action, linking to the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` it generated. Subject- and tenant-scoped like any other portal object; backs the subject's right to a copy of their own submission-log entries. See openspec/specs/supplier-portal/spec.md (wmebv-submission-receipts).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The submitting subject; the field this log is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this submission belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app whose `type: create` action was submitted.

actionId.title: Action id
actionId.description: The declared action id that was submitted.

payloadCopy.title: Payload copy
payloadCopy.description: A copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the same map the domain create persisted, never the raw client body.

receiptMessageRef.title: Receipt message reference
receiptMessageRef.description: Links to the `referenceId` of the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` this submission generated.

deliveryStatus.title: Delivery status
deliveryStatus.description: The receipt's retriability signal: `delivered` once the receipt message was written, `failed` when the receipt/log side-effect threw (retriable — the domain create itself is never lost).

portalAuditEntry.title: Portal Audit Entry
portalAuditEntry.description: Append-only, portal-owned audit-trail fact record (portal-session-hardening-v2): written on every portal mutation (create/update/forward), every download, and every session event (login/logout/refresh). Never carries payload content — records THAT a verb happened against a target, not the data. Exposed count-only via MetricsController; never publicly readable. Retention is OpenRegister's records-management concern (Archiefwet) — see openspec/changes/portal-session-hardening-v2/design.md.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: The acting/affected session's token id, when known (empty for the download hook, which does not carry one).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject the event belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app recording the entry (defaults to portaliq's own id).

register.title: Target register
register.description: The target register (or, for a forwarded action which touches no register directly, the contributing appId).

schema.title: Target schema
schema.description: The target schema (or, for a forwarded action, the declared action id).

id.title: Target id
id.description: The target object id (empty for session events and forwarded actions, which have no single object id).
